verdict.rationale: Datadog documents official Agent Observability SDKs for both Python and Node.js. They offer automatic and manual instrumentation APIs, and the Python side has a concrete `ddtrace-run` setup path. Missing for 10: explicit TypeScript support or typings, Node.js-specific setup detail comparable to Python's, documentation for general (non-LLM) app tracing SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs are available for Python, Node.js, Java, and Go (experimental).
This page demonstrates using Datadog's Agent Observability SDK to instrument a Python, Node.js, or Java LLM application.
Agent Observability SDKs provide automatic instrumentation as well as manual instrumentation APIs
Enable Agent Observability by running your application using the `ddtrace-run` command and specifying the required environment variables.
